item.title: Project Manager - Los Angeles, CA, United States
item.ukg:briefDescription: We are seeking a dedicated, highly organized, and results-oriented Project Manager to join our global Disaster Risk Management group, which specializes in disaster risk reduction, response, reconstruction, and urban resilience. With experience responding to over 100 global and U.S. disasters, our data-driven, multidisciplinary approach addresses economic, political, socio-cultural, sustainability, and technical challenges in some of the world's most demanding environments. We excel at developing strategies for post-conflict and disaster recovery, including creating resilient, affordable housing systems that empower communities to rebuild and thrive.

item.title: Sr Project Engineer - Las Vegas, NV, United States
item.ukg:briefDescription: We are currently seeking a Sr. Project Engineer to be based out of our Las Vegas office. This position is one of the most exciting roles in our company. We are establishing our Las Vegas presence after years of successfully delivering projects in the region remotely. We have now made the strategic decision to build a permanent team and grow this practice locally, and you will play a key role in that expansion. You will work directly with senior structural engineers in California and Reno who will actively mentor you, support your technical development, and involve you in meaningful project work from day one. You will gain hands on experience in client management, business development, communication, and coordination with architects, contractors, and multidisciplinary teams.
